summary.shortDescription: Provisional research record for Tenpower INR21700-50XG.
summary.description: Tenpower identifies INR21700-50XG as a 5000mAh 21700 cell. Battery Mooch tested the exact model and estimated 40A continuous current, while noting that the tested cells lacked CCC marks and appeared pre-production.
highlights: Exact model identity is supported by Tenpower data and an exact-model vaping test.
Discovery value is 5000mAh and 40A continuous; 90A is temperature-limited and 140A is pulse-only.
The tested samples appeared pre-production; production continuity remains unresolved.
Runtime admission is recorded as battery-87.
Runtime admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.
